thesis: Identify the protectable component, exclusive act and legal basis rather than treating labor, meaning or products as one property right.
role: Build the rights-layer vocabulary and ownership record.

ideas.statement: Copyright protects qualifying expression and sometimes creative arrangement, not facts, ideas or methods; nonliteral copying can remain infringing.
Authorship, ownership, licence, assignment and moral rights differ; component-level chains of title need evidence and accurate AI contribution records.
Permission, contextual exceptions and public-domain status are distinct; attribution is neither permission nor identical to academic honesty.
Trademarks, patents, secrets, contracts and database rights protect different interests and cannot manufacture ownership of every useful feature.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: A translation changes words while remaining an adaptation; a new explanation of the same subject need not be derivative.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Feist is US authority; exceptions and duration differ nationally; neither online availability nor buying a copy supplies universal permission.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
